title: Roads not taken: The mismatch between safety and regulation of plant breeding innovation
title_zh: 未被探索的道路：植物育种创新的安全性与监管错位
abstract: Meeting global food security goals while reducing agriculture's environmental impact requires continued crop improvement and innovation. Advances in transgenesis, cisgenesis, and genome editing now enable increasingly precise genetic modification with risks comparable to those of conventional breeding, yet regulatory frameworks remain focused on the method used rather than the product. We highlight recent examples, including immune receptor transfer, cisgenesis-based disease resistance stacking, photosynthesis engineering, and AI-guided protein design, that illustrate innovations constrained by current regulatory approaches. A decisive shift toward science-based, proportionate, and product-focused regulation is needed so that improved crops are evaluated on the basis of their properties, not how they were made.
abstract_zh: 为实现全球粮食安全目标并减少农业环境影响，持续的作物改良与创新至关重要。转基因、同源转基因以及基因组编辑的进步，使得基因修饰日益精准，其风险与传统育种相近，然而监管框架仍聚焦于修饰手段而非产品本身。我们综述了近期案例，包括免疫受体转移、同源转基因抗病性堆叠、光合作用工程以及AI引导的蛋白质设计，阐释了当前监管方式如何制约创新。必须向科学依据、适度且以产品为导向的监管转型，以便根据作物性状而非其生产方式对改良作物进行评估。
